## Where I'm at

Daniel is replacing the HubSpot webhook sync with a 15-minute polling job, so the admin accounts page can show AE owner and ARR. Webhooks were dropped because private app tokens can't manage webhook subscriptions. PR #405 is closed, and #409 is open (auto-merge was set, but a required CI check is failing). Trials (ARR = 0) are excluded on purpose.

- [en-cours] PR #409 is open with a failing e2e check: `tests/e2e/test_admin_accounts.py::test_accounts_table_shows_owner` expects 3 owner rows, gets 2. Auto-merge is blocked until it passes.
- [prochaine-étape] Fix the e2e fixture (give the third company ARR > 0 or expect 2 rows), then push and let CI run again.
- [prochaine-étape] Noa adds `HUBSPOT_TOKEN` to AWS Secrets Manager for staging and prod.
- [essai-raté] Registering webhook subscriptions via the HubSpot API: refused with 401, since private app tokens can't manage them. Hence the switch to polling.
- [question] Existing trial accounts that already have an owner from an old manual import keep it; nothing clears them. Whether that is acceptable is still open.
- [décision] Only sync companies with ARR > 0 and skip trials completely; the admin page is not meant to show them (source: t10)
- [décision] Close #405 and replace webhooks with polling every 15 minutes (source: t04)
